disclaimer: These records define a reproducible pilot queue; they are not completed tests, measured outcomes, or official implementation commitments.

record_contract.meaning: Project Records are design-review bundles. They do not confer administrative permission, land rights, procurement, funding, or public endorsement.

roots.label: 自立 / Self-reliant making
roots.choice: 研究—工程—标准—转化进入 ORIGINATE→TEST→ADOPT

roots.label: 共享 / Shared commons
roots.choice: 公园先服务日常；开放内容与人工路径并置

roots.label: 韧性 / Reversible resilience
roots.choice: 阶段门、人工接管、退出审计、复原和申诉成套出现

roots.label: 节制 / Quiet intensity
roots.choice: 90% 安静公共生活、10% 高强度节点；优先存量更新

rooted_design_matrix.review_rule: Roots explain design fit; they do not establish statutory controls, official boundaries, government endorsement, funding, procurement, or measured performance.

project_records.name: ORIGINATE｜北京 AI 原点社区
project_records.purpose: 把高校源头创新转译为可公开讨论、可人工复核、可继续试验的城市问题解法。
project_records.evidence_gate: human baseline comparison + data minimization + community review
project_records.fallback: human service desk, paper map, manual case manager and public notice
project_records.sunset_condition: 90-day review; no renewal without run receipts and community review

project_records.name: TEST｜众智园 AI 自主创新加速区
project_records.purpose: 在封闭、可复原的环境中完成物理 AI、安全和标准验证，再考虑与公园接口连接。
project_records.operator_candidate: independent safety review board + test-site operator (candidate; unconfirmed)
project_records.evidence_gate: safety review passed + independent review + zero public-realm intrusion
project_records.fallback: stop test, isolate the site, restore the surface and publish a discrepancy note
project_records.sunset_condition: test permit window ends; re-review before any extension

project_records.name: ADOPT｜大钟寺 AI 产业聚集区
project_records.purpose: 让经过试验的服务在真实城市中被居民、商户和劳动者使用，并保留人工选择。
project_records.evidence_gate: real-user observation + zero public-space intrusion + exit drill
project_records.fallback: staffed counter, paper map, manual dispatch and route closure
project_records.sunset_condition: 90-day launch review; complaints or safety degradation trigger RETURN
